name: @gabriellsales/discord-mcp

tools.name: apply_layout
tools.description: Recreate a saved layout in a server: creates the missing roles, categories and channels with their permissions. Roles and channels that already exist with the same name are reused, never changed or deleted. Call without confirm first to see the plan, then with confirm=true once the user agrees.

server.description: Server to build the layout in (id or name). Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

apply_everyone_permissions.description: Also replace the server-wide permissions of @everyone with the layout's. Default false.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true does it. Only set true after the user agreed to the preview.

tools.name: check_permissions
tools.description: Work out what a role or member can actually do, server-wide or in one channel, after roles and channel overrides are applied.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

target.description: Role (name or id; everyone for @everyone) or member (name or id).

target_type.description: role or member, when the name could be either.

channel.description: Channel to check. Omit for server-wide permissions.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a text, voice, announcement, stage, forum or media channel, or a category. Can place it in a category (inheriting its permissions) and make it private to chosen roles or members.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

name.description: Channel name. Discord lowercases text channel names and turns spaces into hyphens.

type.description: text (default), voice, category, announcement, stage, forum or media.

category.description: Category to create the channel in (id or name). Its permissions are copied, so the channel starts synced.

slowmode_seconds.description: Seconds each member waits between messages, 0-21600.

bitrate.description: Voice bitrate in bits per second, 8000-96000 without boosts.

user_limit.description: Voice user limit, 0-99 (0 means no limit).

position.description: Sort position inside its category, 0 is the top.

private.description: Hide from @everyone. Only the roles or members in visible_to (and admins) will see it.

visible_to.description: Roles or members that can see a private channel.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: create_role
tools.description: Create a role with a name, color, server-wide permissions, and display options.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

color.description: Hex color such as #5865F2. Default: no color.

permissions.description: Server-wide permissions, e.g. manage_messages, kick_members, moderate_members. Default: none (members still get @everyone's).

hoist.description: Show members with this role separately in the member list.

position.description: Place in the hierarchy; 1 is just above @everyone. Default: bottom.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a channel or category and its messages, permanently. Channels inside a deleted category are kept, without a category. Call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user agrees.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

channel.description: Channel or category id, #name, name or category/name.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true does it. Only set true after the user agreed to the preview.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: delete_layout
tools.description: Delete a saved layout. Servers built from it are not touched.

tools.name: delete_role
tools.description: Delete a role, taking it from every member who has it. Call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user agrees.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true does it. Only set true after the user agreed to the preview.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: find_members
tools.description: Find members by the start of their username or nickname, with their roles. Needs the Server Members intent enabled for the bot.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

query.description: Start of a username or nickname.

limit.description: How many members to return, 1-50. Default 10.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Show one channel or category with its settings and every permission override, by role or member, as allowed and denied permission names.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Show a saved layout in full: roles, categories, channels and their permissions.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Show a server's settings (verification, notifications, content filter, system/rules/AFK channels), counts, and the bot's own role and permissions there.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

tools.name: invite_bot
tools.description: Get the link that adds the bot to another server. The user opens it, picks the server and clicks Authorize; they need Manage Server there. The new server is usable right after, without restarting.

server_id.description: Id of the server to preselect (Discord: right-click the server icon > Copy Server ID). Optional: without it the user picks the server on the page.

admin.description: Ask for Administrator instead of the individual permissions.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Show the server's channels as the sidebar does: categories in order with their channels, each with id, type, topic, whether it is private and whether its permissions are synced with the category.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: List the saved server layouts with what each contains.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List the server's roles from the top of the hierarchy: color, member count, server-wide permissions, and whether the bot can manage each one.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List the Discord servers the bot is in, with member counts and what the bot may manage in each.

tools.name: organize_channels
tools.description: Reorder channels, or categories, in one go, optionally moving the channels into a category first. Channels you do not list keep their relative order below the listed ones.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

channels.description: Channels in the order they should appear, top first. To order categories, list only categories.

category.description: Move the listed channels into this category first (id or name), or none for no category. Omit to keep each channel where it is.

sync_permissions.description: When moving, also take the new category's permissions.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: save_layout
tools.description: Save a server's structure as a reusable layout: roles (names, colors, permissions, order), @everyone's permissions, categories and channels in order, topics, slowmode and per-role channel permissions. Messages and members are not saved.

server.description: Server to copy the structure from (id or name). Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

name.description: Layout name, e.g. Comunidade padrão. Saving with an existing name replaces it.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Post a message as the bot, for example rules or a welcome text in a new channel. Public: call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user approves. Mentions do not ping unless allow_mentions is set.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

content.description: Message text, Discord Markdown, up to 2000 characters.

allow_mentions.description: Let @everyone, @here, role and user mentions notify people. Default false: they render but do not ping.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true does it. Only set true after the user agreed to the preview.

tools.name: set_channel_permissions
tools.description: Allow, deny or reset permissions for a role or member in one channel or category (a permission override). Changes merge into the current override unless replace is set. On a category, channels synced with it are updated too. Use target everyone with deny view_channel to make a channel private.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

channel.description: Channel or category id, #name, name or category/name.

target.description: Role (name, @name or id; everyone for @everyone) or member (name or id) the override is for.

target_type.description: role or member, when the name could be either. Default: roles are tried first.

allow.description: Permissions to allow here, e.g. view_channel, send_messages, connect.

reset.description: Permissions to set back to inherit (neither allowed nor denied).

replace.description: Start from an empty override instead of changing the current one.

remove.description: Delete this target's override entirely; allow, deny and reset are ignored.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: set_member_roles
tools.description: Give roles to, or take roles from, a member.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

member.description: Member user id, mention or name.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: update_channel
tools.description: Rename a channel, change its topic, slowmode, NSFW flag, voice settings or position, move it to another category, or sync its permissions with its category. Only the fields you pass change.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

topic.description: New topic. Empty string clears it.

category.description: Move into this category (id or name), or none to take it out of its category.

sync_permissions.description: Replace the channel's permissions with its category's (after any move).

position.description: New sort position. To reorder many channels use organize_channels.

slowmode_seconds.description: Seconds between messages per member, 0 turns slowmode off.

bitrate.description: Voice bitrate in bits per second.

user_limit.description: Voice user limit, 0 means no limit.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: update_role
tools.description: Change a role: name, color, permissions (replace, add or remove), display options, or its place in the hierarchy. Works on @everyone too, to change what every member can do.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

role.description: Role id, @name or name. everyone is the @everyone role.

color.description: Hex color such as #5865F2, or none.

permissions.description: Replace all server-wide permissions with these.

add_permissions.description: Permissions to add, keeping the rest.

remove_permissions.description: Permissions to remove, keeping the rest.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the member list.

position.description: New place in the hierarchy; 1 is just above @everyone.

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

tools.name: update_server
tools.description: Change server settings: name, description, verification level, default notifications, content filter, system/rules/AFK channels, AFK timeout, locale. Only the fields you pass change.

server.description: Server id or name. Optional when the bot is in a single server or a default is configured.

description.description: New description (Community servers). Empty string clears it.

verification_level.description: none, low, medium, high or very_high.

system_channel.description: Channel for welcome and boost messages, or none.

afk_channel.description: Voice channel for idle members, or none.

afk_timeout.description: Idle seconds before moving to the AFK channel: 60, 300, 900, 1800 or 3600.

preferred_locale.description: Locale such as pt-BR or en-US (Community servers).

reason.description: Optional note recorded in the server's audit log.

instructions: Manage Discord servers through the user's bot: channels, categories, roles, permissions and member roles. Servers, channels, roles and members can be named instead of using ids. Call list_channels and list_roles before reorganizing. delete_channel, delete_role and send_message call first without confirm to get a preview, show it to the user, and repeat with confirm=true only after they agree.
